# pcd_networking_router (Data Source)

Look up a Neutron router by ID or filters. Exactly one router must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_networking_router" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-router"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Filter by (and report) the administrative state.
- `description` (String) Filter by (and report) the description.
- `name` (String) Filter by (and report) the name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `router_id` (String) Look up by router ID (takes precedence over filters).
- `status` (String) Filter by (and report) the operational status.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `enable_snat` (Boolean) Whether source NAT is enabled on the gateway.
- `external_network_id` (String) The external network the router's gateway is attached to.
- `id` (String) The router ID.
